surface: src/plate_core/plate_config.py, src/plate_core/health.py, gh plate config validate/show, gh plate health
summary: Treat a .plate/ directory as an unrecognized layout: clear PlateConfigError, non-zero CLI exits without traceback, and health no longer reports MISSING when GitHub already has a root .plate file.
migration_impact: Repos with a legacy .plate/ folder see actionable errors for local directory-to-file migration instead of IsADirectoryError, MISSING remote config, or bootstrap attempting to replace an existing remote .plate without its SHA.
migration_guidance: 1. Back up files under .plate/, remove or rename the directory.
2. Create a local root `.plate` JSON file; port supported settings from any legacy `.plate/config` YAML.
3. Run `gh plate config validate`, commit the migration, then run `gh plate bootstrap --adopt --apply` only if the remote repo still lacks a root `.plate` file (see docs/migration/adoption-guide.md).
agent_notes: plate-core expects a single JSON file at .plate; use get_plate_config_report or plate_directory_layout_error_message() for the canonical text.
